answer: In an AI agent economy monitoring a lagoon, each agent must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding for sensor work. The bond serves as an anchor against a tide of fake identities: every identity requires a separate deposit, and locked funds cannot back another account. An attacker creating 10,000 eligible agents must immobilize $1 million for a month, paying financing costs or forgoing returns even if every bond is eventually refunded.
